tokens.name: brand-midnight
tokens.usage: Brand Midnight. App-icon field, the splash background and primary text in light theme (`ink`). Never a button fill.

tokens.name: brand-gateway-blue
tokens.usage: Brand Gateway Blue. The symbol's gate, large fills and illustrations. For text and filled buttons use `primary`: white on this blue is 4.2:1 and fails small text.

tokens.name: brand-access-mint
tokens.usage: Brand Access Mint. The symbol's access plane and the granted/connected signal on Midnight (11:1). A signal, never decoration; never as text on light grounds.

tokens.name: brand-cloud
tokens.usage: Brand Cloud. Light background for marketing surfaces and the splash in light theme.

tokens.name: brand-slate
tokens.usage: Brand Slate. Secondary text in brand material; in the app use `on-surface-variant`.

tokens.name: brand-denied
tokens.usage: Brand Denied. Denied states in brand material on Midnight (6.2:1). In the app use `danger`.

tokens.name: brand-pending
tokens.usage: Brand Pending. Pending approval in brand material on Midnight (11:1). In the app use `warning`.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Window background behind scrolling content (`MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background`).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App bars, bottom navigation and grouped list backgrounds (`colorScheme.surface`).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs and sheets on `surface` (Material `surfaceContainer`). Added: Theme.kt leaves it to Material's default.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `background`, `surface` and `surface-raised` (≥14:1 both themes).

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, timestamps, helper text, section labels, on all three grounds (≥6.6:1).

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, outlined buttons and selectable rows (≥3.3:1 on every ground light; 3.4:1 on raised dark).

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows and card edges; decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Filled buttons, links, selected tabs and switches; text accent on every ground (≥4.5:1).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` fills (4.8:1 light, 7.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: mark-surface
tokens.usage: Monogram tile and selected-row tint (Theme.kt: Gateway Blue at 8% / 12-14% over the ground).

tokens.name: mark-foreground
tokens.usage: Monogram letters on `mark-surface`. Exact source pair: 3.8:1 in light misses 4.5:1 for 14sp text; use `primary` (4.4:1) or 16sp+ semibold when you need it legible as text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Connected, approved, granted. Text and icons on every ground (≥4.8:1). Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-container
tokens.usage: Background of a success chip or banner; text on it is `success`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending approval, expiring, degraded; the favorite star. Text and icons on every ground (≥4.8:1).

tokens.name: warning-container
tokens.usage: Background of a pending chip or banner; text on it is `warning`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Denied, destructive actions, high-risk badges, errors (≥6.2:1). Only for those; never for emphasis.

tokens.name: danger-container
tokens.usage: Background of an error banner or high-risk badge; text on it is `danger` or `ink`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2dp keyboard/D-pad focus ring around controls (≥4:1 light, ≥9.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs and bottom sheets.

styles.name: headline-small
styles.usage: State screens (locked, empty, error): one per screen. Compose headlineSmall + SemiBold.

styles.name: title-large
styles.usage: Top app bar titles. Compose titleLarge.

styles.name: title-medium
styles.usage: Dialog and sheet titles, card headings. Compose titleMedium.

styles.name: title-small
styles.usage: Monogram letters and dense headings. Compose titleSmall + SemiBold.

styles.name: body-large
styles.usage: List row titles and the request line of an approval (SemiBold there). Compose bodyLarge.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Default running text, field values, banner titles (SemiBold). Compose bodyMedium.
styles.sample: Unlock your vault to access your items.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Supporting text, banner detail, diagnostics. Compose bodySmall.

styles.name: label-medium
styles.usage: Field labels above values. Compose labelMedium.

styles.name: label-small
styles.usage: SECTION LABELS, uppercase, in `on-surface-variant`. Compose labelSmall + SemiBold.

styles.name: mono-medium
styles.usage: Revealed secrets, TOTP codes, commands, identifiers.

styles.name: mono-small
styles.usage: Request digests in approval dialogs, fingerprints, member ids.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: icon to badge.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Label to value inside a field.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a field row; gap between stacked cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap inside a banner or between inline chips.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row (`gutterSmall`); banner vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Card inner padding; gap above a card's action row.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: List row and banner horizontal padding; section label inset.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Screen gutter (`KeyleaseDimens.gutter`); gap above state-screen details.

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Gap above the action stack on a state screen.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: State screen horizontal padding.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Risk and status chips.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Select fields, inset code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-mark
tokens.usage: Monogram tile (44dp and 64dp).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards (Material 3 Card, shape medium).

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Buttons: Material 3 full shape on a 40dp height.

tokens.name: radius-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the top corners of bottom sheets (Material 3 extraLarge).

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for every tappable thing (icon buttons included).

tokens.name: mark-size
tokens.usage: Monogram in list rows (`KeyleaseDimens.markSize`).

tokens.name: mark-size-large
tokens.usage: Monogram in an item's detail header (`largeMarkSize`).

tokens.name: state-icon
tokens.usage: Icon on a state screen.
